manufacturer.name: Danmar Doors
manufacturer.note: Australian garage door manufacturer. Recorded with no documents on purpose. Its WA arm publishes an installation-guides page, which is registered as a harvest target, but no Danmar-branded manual PDF surfaced. Search did return two Australian roller-door opener manuals - an MR555MYQ and an ET30 - but neither carries Danmar branding, and attaching another brand's opener manual to this record is exactly the substitution this library refuses to make.
